Milestone 1 Overview
The goal of Milestone 1 was to make a step-change progress in the development of an open-source framework for the Winter Protocol - a tokenization and traceability protocol. As part of this milestone, key outputs were completed. These include:

・Completion of the first iteration of smart contracts
・Open source library, complete with positive tests, available on github and npm
・Documentation of the winter protocol and respective library 
・Tokenization and traceability schemas available on the documentation website
・Competed design of explorer and on-chain asset viewer

・Deliverable - Open Source Github Library - LINK

Milestone 2 Supplementary Evidence and Outputs:

Determining the required functionalities for the APIs & Compatibility with Languages:
The backend API is built to work with the winter cardano library (Github Link). It contains end-to-end code to singleton mint, perform contract recreation, and contract spend. The backend processes all transactions with a centralized wallet, while maintaining scalability. It also indexes data to a database for convenience. Clients can communicate with the backend via REST API, allowing any languages to leverage it. 

Updated Documentation (demonstrating Milestone 4 progress - which is about documentation)- LINK to most recent documentation (noting that Milestone 4 requires us to finish the documentation, we are just attaching it here as it provides some useful context to the project).

As a reminder, 
・Singleton Mint: This represents the creation of an object/commodity or it can also represent an event. Data is written to the utxo guarded by the smart contract which contains the freshly minted singleton (tracking) token.

・Contract Recreation: This represents an error correction of an object or event. A new utxo holding the original singleton and lovelace value is made from the inputs of the original one. Contract preserves protocol version and signers. It also makes sure the original transaction is always referenced. The data reference portion is required to change since recreation is only done for corrections.

・Contract Spend: This represents a decommission of an object or event. The singleton token is burned.
・
